messages:
maya (Product PM): Quick triage — need to prioritize inference perf work for next sprint. RICE-ish scoring incoming but want aligned sequencing. Candidates:

1) KV cache eviction + prefix caching (reduce p50 for short chats)
2) Batch scheduler + sequence-aware batching (increase throughput)
3) Quantization rollout + A/B on impact (reduce token cost)
4) Predictive prefetch for embeddings (lower tail latency for search)

My ask: quick RICE numbers and one-line risk notes. No long writeups, please. 

liam (Eng Runtime): +1. My rough RICE: 1) Reach=0.6 Impact=8 Conf=0.7 Effort=3 -> score ~ 112
2) Reach=0.9 Impact=7 Conf=0.6 Effort=5 -> ~76
3) Reach=0.8 Impact=6 Conf=0.5 Effort=4 -> ~60
4) Reach=0.4 Impact=5 Conf=0.4 Effort=2 -> ~40

olivia (Eng-ML): For quant rollout we need eval set + regen. Risk: hallucination shift on low-temp models. Suggest canary on 10% of traffic.

harry (SRE): Operational concerns: batch scheduler increases p95 under bursty traffic if not tuned. Need circuit breaker + metrics (queue depth, batch latency). Also estimate infra push: +1-2 GPUs for stability in canary.

tara (Sales): We have ACME and Nova on calls asking for lower unit cost — they'd prefer quant prioritised if impact stays within 2% quality.

nora (Customer Success): Customer-facing criteria: launch if upstream eval shows <=1.5% regression on top-3 prompts and rollout plan + rollback documented.

deploy-bot: Deploy window suggestion: canary on Tue 09:00 PT -> monitor 2h -> auto-roll if error rate >1% or mean latency increase >15%.

maya (Product PM): Proposed sequencing: 1) KV cache (low effort, immediate customer win) -> 2) Quant canary (because sales ask) -> 3) Batch scheduler (bigger infra work) -> 4) Prefetch experiments (research-y)

liam (Eng Runtime): Agree. Small nit: do KV + quant in parallel teams if we can spare eng-ml. Otherwise switch order #2/#3.

olivia (Eng-ML): We can spin up evaluation harness this week. I'll own quant canary plan with nora.

tara (Sales): I'll brief ACME/Nova on canary expectations and reconvene after canary metrics.

maya (Product PM): Action items:
- liam: rough infra effort (hrs) for batching + circuit-breakers by EOD
- olivia: quant canary plan + eval set by Thu
- harry: define 3 monitoring SLOs for canary
- nora/tara: customer communication template

Please put quick numbers in thread. We'll do a 10-min sync tomorrow to lock sprint triage. :thumbsup:
